description: The plot illustrates the Mean Interclass Similarity across different Relation Categories for three distinct configurations, comparing their performance. The x-axis, labeled "Relation Category," ranges from 0 to 60 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Mean Interclass Similarity," spans from 0.0 to 0.5 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The blue line, representing "w/o DPO obo," starts at approximately 0.5 and fluctuates, ending around 0.05, with notable peaks at relation categories 1 and 31. The orange line, representing "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," begins around 0.086 and also fluctuates, ending near 0.05, with significant peaks at categories 2, 14, 28, and 32. The green line, representing "DPO," starts at about 0.23 and ends around 0.08, showing variability across the categories. Additionally, the average values for "w/o DPO obo," "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," and "DPO" are represented by dotted lines in blue, orange, and green, respectively, with values of approximately 0.107, 0.158, and 0.086.
